description:
HushTelegram v0.0.17 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.2 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 13.0.2 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 68 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: patching on a phone no longer fails when HushTelegram icon and name, Black and white launch logo or Use registered Maps API key is picked. HushTelegram settings has a new look with a Restart Telegram row and Quick setups, and pressing and holding the Telegram title on your chat list opens it. There are four new privacy switches, including ones that keep your drafts and searches on your phone.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 1129 runtime tests passed locally. All 447 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 68 patches applied to Telegram 13.0.2 and the 13.0.2 beta without forcing, and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.2, version code 71759, or the beta 13.0.2, version code 71809. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from v0.0.13, patch 13.0.2 and install it over your current build with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram first and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
